methods.label: Normal Search / Full Table Scan
methods.description: Sequential scan baseline. Index scans and bitmap scans are disabled for this measurement, so PostgreSQL must read the table sequentially.

comparability.note: Same parsed filters and keyword predicate as the other relational methods; index scans are disabled by design.

methods.label: B+ Tree Search
methods.description: PostgreSQL B-tree indexes on price_inr, category and rating support equality and range predicates. The actual chosen index is shown in the query plan.

comparability.note: Same parsed filters and keyword predicate as the relational baseline; the planner chooses indexes naturally.

methods.label: Hash Index Search
methods.description: A PostgreSQL hash index on brand accelerates equality lookups. Hash indexes do not support ranges or sorting; queries without a brand cannot use this index.

comparability.note: Same query as the relational baseline; hash index applies only when a brand equality predicate exists.

methods.label: Composite B+ Tree Search
methods.description: A multicolumn B-tree on (category, price_inr, color). The leading-column rule means category is required for the index to be applicable.

comparability.note: Same query as the relational baseline; the composite index applies only when category is constrained.

methods.label: HNSW Vector Search
methods.description: Cosine-distance semantic search over 384-dimensional product embeddings using a pgvector HNSW index. No structured filters are applied.

comparability.note: Returns approximate semantic nearest neighbours without structured filters. Result semantics differ from relational methods; query embedding time is reported separately.

methods.label: B+ Tree + HNSW Hybrid Search
methods.description: Combines structured relational filters with semantic similarity. Structured predicates are evaluated by PostgreSQL while the embedding ranks the remaining candidates.

comparability.note: Uses structured filters plus semantic ranking. Result ordering differs from relational methods; embedding time is reported separately.

methods.label: Cached Search
methods.description: Application-level TTL/LRU cache in front of hybrid search. The first query is a miss; repeated identical queries are hits that skip both embedding generation and database execution.

comparability.note: Timing depends on cache state: the first run is a miss, later runs are hits. Cache hits avoid the database entirely.
